name: Advancing Front Isosurface Extraction with Guidance Field
definition: A robust method for extracting isosurfaces from implicit functions using an advancing front algorithm guided by a scalar field g(x) that constrains edge lengths based on surface curvature and user parameters.
summary: Advancing Front Isosurface Extraction with Guidance Field extracts isosurfaces using a scalar field to bound triangle aspect ratios and Hausdorff distance, solving front interference issues inherent in standard adaptive algorithms.
